svg.text: RANGMANCH SCENE KEYFRAME: SC01 (INT. HAVELI COURTYARD)
Atmosphere: Morning Light | Architecture: Sandstone Haveli & Neem Courtyard

foreignObject.div:
Cinematic Still Prompt:
Cinematic 35mm film still of a rural Malwa haveli open courtyard. Golden morning rays filtering through the canopy of an ancient neem tree onto weathered yellow sandstone slabs. Amar stands by the stone verandah holding a wax-sealed envelope; Ram Singh sits composed at a low wooden ledger desk. Authentic period atmosphere.

svg.text: Dramatic Purpose: Filial Authority vs Immediate Legal Peril | Composition: 2.39:1 Aspect Ratio
